plugins.Name: Ice's Cosmic Exploration (XivHub fork)
plugins.Punchline: Automate Cosmic Exploration: relics, gathering, and crafter leveling.
plugins.Description: A little helper to go gather your heart out.

plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: FeteTimer
plugins.Description: Calibrates the Ishgardian Restoration Fête (Skyrise Celebration) countdown from the in-game objective list while you are in the Firmament and fires configurable chat, notification, and sound alerts at your chosen lead times.

plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: SealHunter
plugins.Punchline: Automate your hunting logs (Grand Company and class/job).
plugins.Description: Works through your hunting logs for you — Grand Company (seals) or the current class/job log (XP), selectable in settings. Teleports/flies to each zone, walks to targets with vnavmesh, and clears the required marks using BossMod Reborn autorotation. Requires vnavmesh, Lifestream, and BossMod Reborn. Optional AutoDuty for the GC log's dungeon marks.

plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: InventoryCleaner
plugins.Punchline: Keep only the gear you actually use.
plugins.Description:
Tidies the Armoury Chest against your saved gearsets. Anything equipped, referenced by a gearset, or a higher-ilvl upgrade for a job you still play is kept; everything else is moved out to your bags, fullest armoury container first, so the run frees space where it is tightest. Every run is previewed item by item with the reason for each decision, and nothing moves until you confirm.

Also does the reverse (pulling gearset pieces back into the armoury) and offers a discard picker: an icon grid of leftover gear, framed by rarity, where anything equipped, in a gearset, or on your allowlist is never listed.

plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: AutoPincher
plugins.Punchline: One-click undercut of every retainer listing, fully local.
plugins.Description: Repinches your retainer market listings by undercutting the cheapest live competitor by 1 gil. Reads each listing straight from game memory, clicks the in-game market board's Compare Prices to find the current cheapest offering, and sets your asking price to one below it. Your own retainers and housing mannequins are never treated as competitors, so two retainers selling the same item don't chase each other down. No server, no telemetry, nothing leaves your client. Adds an Auto Pinch button next to AutoRetainer's retainer-list controls and a /autopinch command for the open retainer. AutoRetainer is optional (used only to pause its automation during a pinch run).

plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: PartyPlanner Reborn
plugins.Punchline: Browse community events sourced from partake.gg directly from your client!
plugins.Description: Browse community events sourced from partake.gg directly from your client! XIV Hub fork with optional Lifestream travel: change to the event's world, or, with Lifestream + vnavmesh installed, walk straight to the event's housing plot/apartment door.

plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: Blackjack Advisor
plugins.Punchline: Optimal blackjack moves for FFXIV /random card games.
plugins.Description: Enter your hand and the dealer's up card and it tells you the mathematically best move (hit / stand / double / split), computed exactly for the in-game /random 1-13 (infinite-deck) variant. Configurable dealer rules (H17/S17), one-click buttons to say your move in chat (only when you press them, never automatic), and a live gil session tracker.

plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: RetainerReach
plugins.Punchline: Unified retainer inventory grid with one-click retrieve. Requires AllaganTools.
plugins.Description: REQUIRES AllaganTools (a.k.a. Allagan Market / InventoryTools) installed and enabled — RetainerReach reads your retainer inventories from it. Unified view of your active character and all retainers' inventories as an in-game-style icon grid, with one-click Retrieve that summons each holding retainer at a nearby Summoning Bell and pulls selected items into your bags. Search by name, filter by category or crafting material, save recurring pulls as presets, and retrieve from chat via /retrieve. This plugin automates in-game actions (retainer bell interaction and item retrieval) on your behalf; use at your own risk with respect to the game's Terms of Service.
